capabilities: Insert comments and add, delete, highlight, and replace markup tokens around selected text
Toggle Track Changes mode to insert markup automatically while typing
Accept, reject, and resolve tracked changes and comments from a Changes pane
Render and highlight review tokens in Reading View and Live Preview
List comments in a side pane and jump to their locations
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition or reading-review tool; it adds CriticMarkup-style tracked changes and inline comments for editing and peer review.
extras: The plugin is awaiting acceptance into the Obsidian Community Plugins directory; manual installation from GitHub releases is described. It states there is no telemetry, no network calls, and all parsing happens locally.
intentEvidence: Review Critic helps you edit and review notes collaboratively inside Obsidian without leaving Markdown.
motivation: The README says it is built for drafting, peer review, and content polishing workflows where users want tracked-style edits without leaving Markdown.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to make tracked-style edits, inline comments, or peer-review markup while keeping notes as plain, portable Markdown.
summary: CriticMarkup-style tracked changes and comments for Markdown notes, with rendering in Reading View and Live Preview and panes to accept or reject edits.
